thread:
sandeep: sunrise handoff — quick pass from my watch. between ~02:12-02:28 UTC we saw ~12m of elevated 503s on /v1/embeddings eu-west. root cause appears to be autoscaler churn + a redis leader election (nodes had OOM churn) which caused increased latency and some request timeouts. incident-bot paged at 02:13 UTC.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 503-rate > p95 threshold on embeddings-service-eu-west (chan=ingest) — page sent to @oncall. page id: INC-2026-1203

tyler: saw the page, jumped in. confirmed redis failover logs around 02:14:23 UTC. some of the KV cache RPCs timed out and backpressure cascaded into our batcher, causing token generator to return 503s.

fiona: status: traffic rerouted to dedicated-pool-eu1 at 02:16 UTC via routing policy override. also triggered model-variant fallback to small-emb-v2 for long tail requests.

emily: customer impact: about 1.2k requests retried, ~140 unique customers saw errors. most recovered via client retries; we saw transient increase in support tickets (6). no SLO breach escalation required yet, but flagged for postmortem.

sandeep: mitigations performed during shift:
- temporarily increased autoscaler cooldown to 120s for embeddings pool
- forced redis leader pin on node redis-eu-03 to stabilize cluster
- applied routing override to dedicated pool (policy id r-875)
- switched fallback model variant for embeddings requests longer than 512 tokens

fiona: commands I ran (for trace):
```
# pin leader (short lived)
kubectl exec -n infra redis-eu-03 -- redis-cli replicaof no one
# routing override
redwoodctl route override --pool dedicated-pool-eu1 --selector embeddings --until 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z
```

tyler: logs: saw repeated: "kv_rpc timeout after 1200ms" then "batcher stall: inflight > 200" in batcher-2. Confirmed eviction pressure around 02:10–02:18.

emily: runbook pointers for next shift: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscale and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-failover-checklist — follow the RTO checklist first, then routing overrides.

sandeep: open action items before handoff: 
- (tyler) collect heap profiles from batcher-2 & batcher-3 during spike window (02:05–02:30) — priority P1
- (fiona) schedule a controlled autoscaler test in staging to replicate churn 
- (emily) surface top-10 customers affected and attach to incident ticket INC-2026-1203

fiona: I also left a short-lived dashboard snapshot pinned: dashboards/ops/embeddings-eu-west/2026-03-15-02-plot — includes P95/P99 and batcher queue depth.

tyler: note for morgen: if redis leader election repeats, escalate to infra-sre; we may need to bump redis node size or split the leader role.

emily: coverage for next shift — primary: @tyler, secondary: @sandeep. on-call rotation calendar updated. tyler will carry the oncall pager for the next 12h.

sandeep: checklist for next shift (short):
- verify routing override still in place and lift if healthy for 30m
- validate redis cluster health (no election events in past 30m)
- check batcher queue depth, kill runaway batchers if > 300 inflight items
- confirm customer ticket triage is assigned

emily: outstanding risk: there is a scheduled deploy to embeddings-stable at 05:00 UTC — recommend holding or gating it until autoscaler behavior is validated. pinged release-engineering.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy embeds-stable v3.4 -> eu-west at 2026-03-15T05:00:00Z (status: pending)

tyler: acknowledged, I'll coordinate with release-eng to gate it. if we see any new election events I will request a rollback hold.

fiona: one-liner for oncall notes: "02:12–02:28 UTC — transient 503s on embeddings due to autoscaler + redis leader election; routing override and variant fallback mitigated impact; action items: heap profiles, staging autoscaler test, customer list."

sandeep: handing off — tyler primary, sandeep secondary. all mitigations applied; routing override expires 04:00 UTC (can extend if still unstable). please update INC-2026-1203 with any further findings. ping me on DM for anything urgent. :thumbsup:

emily: thanks team. logging this thread to incidents channel and attaching dashboard snapshot. good handoff.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-1203 updated: status -> monitoring, assigned -> tyler.

tyler: taking it. will post an initial quick postmortem plan after collecting heap profiles.

sandeep: end of pass.
